listing.name: Star Wars Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy (single player and multiplayer) (OpenJK / OpenJO)
listing.summary: Use the official OpenJK project Windows player for Jedi Academy with your own matching PC data. Keep original files and the external profile backed up.
listing.original_game_title: Star Wars Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy (single player and multiplayer)

steps.title: Prepare the matching PC game
steps.instruction: Before Play, copy only assets0.pk3, assets1.pk3, assets2.pk3 and assets3.pk3 from your own patched PC GameData/base into base beside the player. Keep the original game installation unchanged and separate. The runtime also ships DLLs in base: keep them intact and copy only the four original asset archives into that folder. Jedi Academy needs its own matching files; Jedi Outcast is a different game. Portcove does not verify original-game identity. Do not copy old executables or DLLs over the official runtime. Customized game/mod layouts can retain an external registration.

steps.title: Keep the correct player and profile
steps.instruction: The managed player follows the Rolling latest build; this channel does not establish gameplay qualification. The managed copy selects openjk_sp.x86_64.exe for single player. Multiplayer remains available by registering your separately prepared openjk.x86_64.exe copy with its actual GameData working folder; openjkded.x86_64.exe is a server. This selected Windows package contains the non-portable home-directory branch: normal saves, configuration and logs use the actual Documents/My Games/OpenJK profile. Back it up separately with your originals and creating runtime before changing versions. Portable builds, unavailable Documents folders and explicit home-path overrides can change the write location; those configurations need their own preserved external registration. A runtime rollback does not rewind external saves or establish older-runtime, mod or recorded-demo compatibility.

steps.title: Keep an existing prepared copy
steps.instruction: Extract the complete official OpenJK-windows-x86_64.zip into the prepared GameData folder. Select openjk_sp.x86_64.exe for single player or openjk.x86_64.exe for multiplayer, with GameData as working directory. A registration selects one player/mode; openjkded.x86_64.exe is a dedicated server, not the player. Retain all package libraries/resources. Existing registrations keep their selected player/mode, arguments, files and user/upstream runtime owner. Removing their registration preserves those files; this catalog change does not adopt or migrate them.

Portcove replaces only its separate official managed runtime and preserves the declared local originals during compatible replacement and backup, including originals copied before first Play. Gameplay, first original setup and populated-save compatibility remain unqualified.
